title: Great Mysteries and Little Plagues
author: John Neal
description: "Great Mysteries and Little Plagues" by John Neal is a collection of essays and stories written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The work delves into the complexities and wonders of childhood, exploring themes around the nature of children, their behaviors, and the lessons they impart.

authorInfo.bio: John Neal (1793–1876) wrote Great Mysteries and Little Plagues. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
